fun_facts: Jordan Love grew up in Bakersfield, California.
Before his senior year of high school, Jordan Love loved basketball and had not yet received a Division I football offer.
In 2018, Jordan Love threw for 3,567 yards and 32 touchdowns, with just six interceptions, while leading Utah State to an 11–2 record.
Jordan Love set five Utah State single-season team records in 2018.
